title: alyssum campestre var. collinum
intro: Alyssum campestre var. collinum, commonly known as mountain alyssum, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. It is also used for its therapeutic actions, such as treating respiratory issues, reducing anxiety and stress, and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of mountain alyssum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
